title: Staleness/version-drift refresh process (GDC/DepMap re-releases)
context: Defines a process to detect when a documented dataset has drifted from its recorded release/freeze (GDC data releases, DepMap quarterly) and to re-open stale docs as maintenance tasks. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Depends on the provenance tool and tcga-017.
objective: Document the staleness/version-drift refresh process that detects drift from the recorded release/freeze and flags schema drift.
acceptanceCriteria: Process detects when a documented dataset has drifted from its recorded release/freeze (GDC data releases, DepMap quarterly); validation flags schema drift; stale docs become maintenance tasks.
